summary: Count to 20, see small groups at a glance, know the last number counted says how many, and write numbers to 10.
Name flat and solid shapes, sort and compare them, build shapes from parts, and use position words.
Compare and order up to 5 things by size or weight, and finish, continue and make repeating patterns.
Help collect answers, show them in a simple graph, and tell which group has more, fewer or the same.
